content: A key problem is that the LAMA setup does not allow to refrain from giving an answer. Generally, prediction probabilities drop in the negated statements, which would suggest the existence of a threshold to filter answers. But a closer look at the probabilities of correct and incorrect predictions shows that they fall into the same range. No common threshold can be found.
